description: Main source file for a Flutter-based To-Do List application implementing UI, state management, and persistence logic.

classes.name: TodoApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up themes and state provider for the to-do app.

classes.name: TodoItem
classes.description: Data model representing a task, with serialization methods.

classes.name: TodoRepository
classes.description: Handles persistence of tasks using SharedPreferences and JSON serialization.

classes.name: TodoStore
classes.description: State management class extending ChangeNotifier, managing task list, loading, updating, and deleting tasks.

classes.name: TodoHomeScreen
classes.description: Main UI widget that displays the to-do list, handles user interactions like adding, editing, deleting tasks.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the app, runs the root widget.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads tasks from persistent storage into the app state.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task with validation and persists changes.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates a task's title and saves changes.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Removes a task with undo support.

methods.name: insertTaskAtTop
methods.description: Inserts a task at the top of the list, often for undo actions.
